# Norte Tech

## Overview
Norte Tech is the tech community of the northern zone (Zona Norte) of Greater Buenos Aires: Founders, Builders, Inversores (investors), Growth, Marketing and Creators. The goal is to build the tech ecosystem of the area from the ground up.

## Key Features
- **Startups & Projects:** Connecting founders with co-founders, early hires, and first users.
- **Knowledge:** Technical workshops, founder talks, and Q&A sessions.
- **Network:** Access to investors, mentors, and corporations in the northern zone.
- **Action:** An active community building real projects together.

## Upcoming Events
- **Kick-off Norte Tech:** The first community gathering (Date & Location TBD).
- **Build with AI Workshop:** Vibe coding session from idea to MVP.
- **Norte Hack #1:** The first hackathon of the community.

## Call to Action
Join the community to start building the future of tech in Zona Norte.
